kebab_example: aliyun pds authorize --client-id 47eUHhrzgWBvlLWj --redirect-uri https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aliyunpds.com%2Fsign%2Fcallback --response-type code --login-type default --region cn-hangzhou
name: Authorize

parameters.help_en: The client ID assigned when you create an app
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The redirect URI specified when you created the app. This URI must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址（创建App时填写的回调地址）。请使用urlencode对链接进行处理
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.help_en: The requested permissions. If omitted, the request defaults to all permissions
parameters.help_zh: 申请的权限列表, 默认为所有权限
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The response type. This parameter must be set to code
parameters.help_zh: 返回类型, 只能填写code
parameters.name: response_type

parameters.help_en: A value to maintain state between the request and callback. This value is returned to your redirect URI. We recommend using this parameter to prevent cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义字段，会在请求授权成功后的callback带回
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:

default (The default PDS login page that integrates all authentication methods)

ding (Log in on a PC by scanning a QR code with DingTalk)

ding_sns (Log in on a mobile phone with a DingTalk username and password)

ram (Log in with an Alibaba Cloud RAM user)

wechat (Log in with WeCom by scanning a QR code)

wechat_app (Single Sign-On (SSO) within the WeCom app)
parameters.help_zh:
认证方式，目前支持以下取值：

default （PDS提供的默认登录页面，集成了所有登录方式）

ding （PC钉钉扫码登录）

ding_sns （手机钉钉账号密码登录）

ram （阿里云子账号登录）

wechat（企业微信扫码登录）

wechat_app（企业微信内免登）
parameters.name: login_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to hide the consent page. Default value: false
parameters.name: hide_consent

schema.title_en: 重定向的登陆页地址，用户需要在此页面完成认证
schema.title_zh: 重定向的登陆页地址，用户需要在此页面完成认证
